# BusinessCart.ai

> Your Commerce, Your Rules.

BusinessCart.ai is a B2B and D2C e-commerce platform. It gives businesses their own branded storefront, per-customer B2B configuration, and direct payment collection — no marketplace fees, no monthly subscriptions.

## What It Does

### Private Commerce (B2B)
- **Private, code-gated access**: Your catalog is private. Customers access it only with your company code.
- **Web portal & mobile app**: Customers browse your catalog, place orders, and track deliveries.
- **Direct payment collection**: Connect Stripe, Amazon Pay, or Authorize.net. Customers pay you directly — we never touch your money.
- **Cart, quotes & checkout**: Full shopping cart, quote-based checkout, payment processing, and order confirmation.
- **Pickup, dropoff, or shipping**: Manage multiple locations with operating hours. Customers pick up, your team drops off, or you ship via carrier.
- **Customer accounts**: Each customer gets their own account with order history, saved addresses, and multi-supplier switching.

### Per-Customer B2B Configuration
- **Per-customer pricing**: Assign a specific discount percentage to each customer, applied automatically.
- **Per-customer payment methods**: Customer A pays via Stripe, Customer B uses purchase orders, Customer C pays cash on pickup.
- **Per-customer delivery options**: Restrict delivery methods per customer — some get shipping, some get pickup only.
- **Order limits & credit**: Set min/max order amounts, quantity limits, monthly/yearly spending caps, and credit limits per customer.
- **Quote negotiation**: Full negotiation workflow — propose, counter-offer, add comments, apply discounts, approve. Complete history preserved.
- **Multi-company customers**: A single buyer can be associated with multiple suppliers, each with independent configurations.
- **Custom catalogs** (coming soon): Assign specific products and categories to each customer.
- **Multi-language & currency** (coming soon): Support for multiple languages and currencies.

### D2C Storefronts
- Every company gets an auto-generated storefront with their branding and custom domain support.
- **Sub-second page load**: Static HTML served from a global CDN.
- **SEO out of the box**: Sitemap, meta tags, OpenGraph, schema.org markup — all generated automatically.
- **AI & LLM ready**: Product catalogs structured for AI tools and voice assistants to understand.
- **99.99% uptime**: Globally distributed, no server to crash.
- **Lower ad costs**: Fast pages and clean code mean higher Google Quality Scores and lower cost-per-click.
- **Accessible & standards-compliant**: Semantic HTML, proper heading structure, mobile-optimized, screen-reader friendly.

### AI-Powered Operations (Premium)
- **AI-driven integration**: Connect your ERP, CRM, and business systems without writing code.
- **AI-driven observability**: Sales, customer, and operations insights without building dashboards.
- **AI-driven inter-communication**: Automated order updates, quote follow-ups, and status notifications.

## How It Works

1. **Create your company account** — Sign up, set your company name, upload your logo, choose brand colors.
2. **Add your products** — Upload your catalog with images, prices, categories, and deal pricing. Connect your payment gateway.
3. **Launch your store** — Your storefront goes live and your portal catalog is ready. Share your company code with customers or your storefront link with the world.

## Pricing

No monthly fees. You only pay per order.

- **Starter** ($0/mo): Private commerce portal, storefront with custom domain, standard checkout, basic B2B configuration, Stripe + offline payments. 6% per order.
- **Growth** ($0/mo): Everything in Starter + negotiable quotes, multiple locations, all payment gateways, full B2B configuration. 5% + $1 per order.
- **Enterprise** (Custom): Everything in Growth + AI-powered integration, AI observability & analytics, AI inter-communication, dedicated support & SLA. Volume pricing.

## Target Audiences

- **B2B**: Manufacturers, distributors, wholesalers who need per-customer pricing, payment terms, and delivery configuration.
- **D2C**: Brands and local businesses who want their own storefront without marketplace commissions.
